name: Filee
title: Filee: free CloudConvert alternative
hook: CloudConvert charges you eight bucks a month. This app does the same job, for free.

features.intro: Converting a file takes one drag.
features.say: Hold a key, drag your files, and drop them on a format in the donut at your cursor.
Over two hundred formats. Images, PDFs, Word, Excel, video, audio, even e-books.
And nothing gets uploaded. It works offline, right on your computer.

caption:
CloudConvert charges $8/month. Filee does the same job for free 🔄

✅ Hold a key, drag files, drop them on a format at your cursor

✅ No subscription, no tracking, 100% free
